notes.title: Rosewater Patch 5
notes.notes:
v 1.05
----------
- Fixed a crash when showing certain inventory items to Nadine in the New Bethel garden
- Fixed a bug where Danny walked to the wrong spot after getting the box from Jimmy
- Balanced Nadine's relationship triggers

notes.title: Rosewater Patch 4
notes.notes:
v 1.04
----------
- Fixed a bug where Harley wouldn't properly stand up and walk out of the hotel lobby after sitting to speak with companions
- Fixed bug where it was possible to access the main menu by pressing Esc in the watch repair closeup and make gears disappear if they were the active cursor
- Fixed bug where it was possible to access the main menu by pressing Esc in the pheasant hunt closeup and would cause the game to hang if a companion was shooting
- Fixed bug where Phil would face the wrong way when showing him the box and would crash the game when speaking to him
- Made hotspot for the wires in the Gannet Island facility more visible
- Fixed a crash that would happen outside Enebro Square Park
- Fixed a bug where background speech wouldn't stay onscreen when voice volume was lowered to 0
- Fixed a bug where wrong diary text would display after putting out the fire at the post office
- Fixed a crash when asking Danny about the communications relay
- Fixed various graphical bugs

notes.title: Rosewater 2-Week Anniversary Patch (v 1.03)
notes.notes:
v 1.03
----------
- Fixed graphical error where foreground object baseline was incorrect in Lola's Wagon Exterior during the forest scenes
- Added companion relationship tracker to New Game+ (Access by pressing Ctrl+R)
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to open the inventory by pressing I while diaries and books were open
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to pick up the pistol from outside the test chamber
- Fixed a bug where pressing pause while the cursor wasn't an inventory item wouldn't reset the correct cursor
- Optimized skipping the opening cutscene
- You can now deliver the box to the union after getting the pin
- Pressing the right mouse button no longer skips cutscenes
- Lowered Danny's high relationship excursion threshold slightly

notes.title: Rosewater Patch 2
notes.notes:
Rosewater has been patched to v 1.02

Changes in this patch:
- Set Dynamic Shadows to off by default on MacOS
- Added note about Dynamic Shadows affecting game performance when hovering over the button in the Settings menu
- Corrected mismatching audio/text for Jem's conversation outside the theater
- Fixed crash when disagreeing with Lola about Geggy's name at the campfire
- Fixed bug where Cormac would fall if you entered the room while he was lassoed
- Fixed characters being lit incorrectly on the wagon after the scrub camp scene
- Fixed random crashes caused by tween transparency timers
- Fixed bug where pressing the hint highlighter right before a cutscene would cause the game to hang
- Fixed bug where Alt+tabbing out of the game while paused in fullscreen would resume the audio when returning, even if paused

Changes in v 1.01:
- Fixed typos in dates in Clark's diary
- Fixed bug in Herbs excursion where leaving the room after sedating the badger made it impossible to give Nadine the snakeroot
- Fixed a potential crash when accessing the menu in the screen with the wagon during the Moving Pictures vignette
- Fixed a bug where Captain Boylan would never sound the dinner gong.
- Fixed a bug where dialogue box would disappear during the final showdown

notes.title: Rosewater Patch - 3/28/25
notes.notes:
Small patch to fix some reported bugs:
- Fixed typos in dates in Clark's diary
- Fixed bug in Herbs excursion where leaving the room after sedating the badger made it impossible to give Nadine the snakeroot
- Fixed a potential crash when accessing the menu in the screen with the wagon during the Moving Pictures vignette
- Fixed a bug where Captain Boylan would never sound the dinner gong.

notes.title: Wild West point & click adventure Rosewater set for release in March with a new trailer
notes.notes: Rosewater from Grundislav Games and publisher Application Systems Heidelberg has a brand new trailer and they've revealed the release date is now set for March 27th.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/wild-west-point-click-adventure-rosewater-set-for-release-in-march-with-a-new-trailer/

notes.title: Rosewater Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Rosewater, the highly anticipated Wild West point & click adventure from Grundislav Games and Application Systems Heidelberg launches on March 27, 2025. 

A new trailer has also dropped on the store page.
